purpose: Enumerate every artifact class the Phase B / Phase D reviewer (a2z-review + the OS team reviewer subagent) ingests when diffing the implementation against the contract. The reviewer compares the current branch's produced artifacts against the contract artifacts (wire_protocol_parity, manualqa_goal_coverage, mission_goal_trace) AND against the prior-state baselines (sibling spec files, prior screenshots). This file is the source-of-truth for 'which artifact comes from which source + which test produces it + which reviewer compares it'.

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Per-route admin UI screenshots at 375px (mobile) + 1280px (desktop) for the 9 admin routes plus the New Site modal and the article edit form
artifact_diff_inputs.producer_tooling: Playwright trace (auto-screenshot on PASS) + manual Playwright `page.screenshot()` calls in admin-ux-parity.spec.ts + dom-snapshot library
artifact_diff_inputs.diff_baseline: develop_target screenshots in api/test-results/ + the prior-state Phase 1.5 baseline screenshots
reviewer_failure_modes: scrollWidth > innerWidth at 375px (mobile overflow per E6 evidence-standards)
missing admin-layout / admin-sidebar / sidebar-nav classes
brand text missing /KoDigital CMS|Homepage CMS/
presence of banned strings: 'TheIWise', 'Phase 1 admin shell', 'Psychic Quiz'
nav-item count < 9

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Outer-HTML snapshots of key admin route containers (admin-layout, admin-sidebar > sidebar-nav, articles table, domains table, modal forms, pages select filters)
reviewer_failure_modes: DOM input id != WPP-NNN.ui_form_fields[].input_id (e.g. id='site_name' would fail WPP-001)
Missing form fields named in WPP rows
Empty-state div present where data rows should render

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Pre/post SELECT outputs for every behavioral AC that asserts a DB state transition (counts, single-row exists, WHERE site_id scoping, settings_version bump)
artifact_diff_inputs.producer_tooling: wrangler d1 execute --local --command='SELECT ... ' + vitest db assertions via env.DB
source_queries: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM site_creation_job_steps WHERE job_id=(SELECT id FROM site_creation_jobs WHERE site_id=X ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pages WHERE site_id=X AND page_type='about'
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_articles_site_slug_unique'
SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_articles_slug_global'
SELECT settings_version FROM site_settings WHERE site_id=X (and Y)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category_verticals WHERE category_id=last_insert_rowid()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tags WHERE site_id=A
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media WHERE site_id=X OR site_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cache_purge_log WHERE dry_run=1
reviewer_failure_modes: Row count != expected (T4.AC2: 15; T6.AC2: 1; T7.AC1: 3; T9.AC2: 5; T10.AC2: 3)
Index name regression (T1.AC2: missing per-site index OR legacy global index present)
settings_version bump on wrong site_id (T8.AC1)
category_verticals row inserted with vertical_id not in site.allowed_verticals (T7.AC2)

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Request/response trace for every behavioral AC that asserts HTTP semantics (status code, header set, body shape). Captured by curl with -i / Playwright request fixture / vitest fetch spy
artifact_diff_inputs.producer_tooling: Playwright `request.post()` returning APIResponse; vitest fetch wrapper; curl -is
diff_target_artifacts: evidence/raw/api_trace_<endpoint>_<RC-id>.json (request line + req headers + req body + status + resp headers + resp body)
reviewer_failure_modes: Status code != expected (T3: 201 / T5.AC2: 403 / T5.AC3: 409 / T7.AC2: 422 / T13.AC2: 404)
Missing required response header (T13.AC2: Cache-Control=no-store, X-Robots-Tag='noindex, nofollow')
Response body leak (T13.AC2: body MUST NOT contain 'cms.kodigital.app')
Body field on wire != UI field name (T3.AC2: 'name' not 'site_name')
Allow-list violation: server accepted body field that should be gated (T5.AC1 case 4)

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Full Playwright trace.zip (DOM snapshots + screenshots + network log + console) for each spec run. Used by the reviewer to replay the test deterministically.
artifact_diff_inputs.producer_tooling: playwright.config.ts:use.trace = 'retain-on-failure' (already configured) + html reporter (configured to write to ./test-results in this mission)
artifact_diff_inputs.diff_baseline: Playwright PASS/FAIL on each test; diff is replay-against-baseline for any test that's been previously green and is now red
diff_target_artifacts: test-results/*.png (per-test screenshots emitted by html reporter)
reviewer_failure_modes: Spec hard-fail (assertion miss)
Test produced no trace (config mis-configured — reuses existing reporter only)
Failed test has no diagnostic artifacts (trace + screenshot + video missing)

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Direct ingest of openspec/changes/<cid>/quality-gauntlet/wire_protocol_parity.json itself — used by the reviewer as the OBJECT of comparison: every wire-protocol field named in this file MUST match what the implementation sends/reads
artifact_diff_inputs.diff_baseline: Implementation source files: api/src/admin/sites-handlers.ts, api/src/admin/api.ts, api/src/admin/templates/*.ts, api/src/site-provisioning/*.ts
reviewer_failure_modes: WPP row's ui_form_fields[].input_id does not appear in named source_file via grep
WPP row's submit_payload_wire_names does not match the form's name="..." attributes
WPP row's server_body_field_reads does not match the handler's destructuring
WPP row's db_columns_written does not match the prepared INSERT/UPDATE column list
WPP row's red_line_substitutions_forbidden detected as PRESENT in implementation source

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Direct ingest of openspec/changes/<cid>/quality-gauntlet/manualqa_goal_coverage.json — used by the reviewer as the OBJECT of comparison: every MQA-N MUST have its named evidence route satisfied at develop_target
artifact_diff_inputs.diff_baseline: Test outputs (vitest + Playwright) + db query outputs + screenshots
reviewer_failure_modes: MQA-N.primary_evidence_route names a test that does not exist
MQA-N.develop_assertion contradicts the test output
MQA-N.in_scope_reqs references a REQ-N not in mission_goal_trace.json
MQA-N.production_assertion uses 'verified' instead of 'deferred_to_ship' (deploy is user-owned, develop cannot 'verify' a live production endpoint)

artifact_diff_inputs.description: Direct ingest of openspec/changes/<cid>/quality-gauntlet/mission_goal_trace.json — REQ-001..030 with story_ids + manualqa_row + required_evidence_routes per requirement. Used as the OUTER coverage map.
artifact_diff_inputs.diff_baseline: manualqa_goal_coverage.json:rows[].in_scope_reqs (every REQ must appear in at least one MQA row)
reviewer_failure_modes: REQ-N has no manualqa_row binding (orphan requirement)
REQ-N has no story_id binding (uncovered scope)
REQ-N has no required_evidence_route (proof-gap)
MQA-N references REQ-N that is not in_scope

reviewer_passes_required: code_quality_reviewer (a2z-review code agent) -> ingests ADI-003, ADI-004, ADI-006
db_security_reviewer (a2z-review DB+security agent) -> ingests ADI-003, ADI-006
ui_visual_parity_reviewer (a2z-review UI+accessibility agent) -> ingests ADI-001, ADI-002, ADI-005
